name: aad-h1pa

provider_reported.read: account_resources() right after the create, known=True

_reserved: 30 GB x $0.07 x 2 months, booked inside the H1-PA PA2v/PA2 $50 envelope from creation (h1pa_governance.spent) until this record states actual_usd
datacenter_choice: live query 2026-10-24T19:00Z: storage support and L40S stock Low in EU-NL-1, EUR-IS-2, US-MO-1, US-NC-1 (OC-AU-1 and US-TX-4 have L40S but no network volumes; US-IL-1 and US-TX-3 no L40S stock); EUR-IS-2 chosen, no measurement distinguishes the four; the volume locks every PA2v/PA2 session to EUR-IS-2 and the L40S
consumer: H1-PA PA2v and PA2: the durable root <mount>/h1pa -- the four new checkpoints, a training's save points while it runs, the evaluation progress and evidence
retention: the four new checkpoints are kept until the preregistered analysis and the maintainer's independent scientific review are complete (h1pa.json :: retention; grant :: storage); then a consumer audit and a migration or retirement proposal go to the maintainer; no AGENTS.md 2.5 automatic retirement before then
retire_by: 2026-12-24 at the end of the reservation, or by the maintainer's lifecycle decision; keeping it past the reservation is booked here first

cost_to_date._provider_observed: logs/budget/provider/runpod_billing_2026-10-25T1512Z.json :: networkvolumes, the 2026-10-24 ($0.0525) and 2026-10-25 ($0.0496, partial day) rows; the provider's volume rows carry no volume id, and am5m373kuq is the account's only network volume since H1's 1980hnh75i was retired on 2026-10-24, so the 2026-10-24 row may still include part of that volume's last day
cost_to_date._run_rate: 30 GB x $0.07/GB-month, billed on the provisioned size, not the bytes on it
cost_to_date.booked: reserved_usd stays the booking until the volume is retired; then actual_usd replaces it

contents_after_pa2.save_points: none: the driver released each training's save points after its checkpoint was persisted and re-identified (units/<unit>/attempts.jsonl :: released)
contents_after_pa2.other: evaluation progress and evidence per unit (bounded by h1pa.json :: storage.bytes.evaluation_per_unit_bound); every unit's evidence is also on the relay and the dev box
contents_after_pa2._basis: the persisted-unit descriptors and the attempt journals; the volume was not re-listed (no pod is running)

consumer_audit.launchers_setups_plans_drivers: none reads them: h1pa_launch stages only E1's packs and the PCA-Original checkpoints from the relay (h1pa.json :: relay_inputs); h1pa_driver writes <mount>/h1pa/<unit>/checkpoint and reads it back only to evaluate the unit it trained; no other script, config or plan names <mount>/h1pa
consumer_audit.analysis: h1pa_analysis reads the six units' evidence only (reports, rows, generation summaries, formal reports), never weights
consumer_audit.declared: the maintainer's independent scientific review (h1pa.json :: retention.new_checkpoints): KEEP until it is complete
consumer_audit.protected_elsewhere: the two PCA-Original checkpoints are E1's, on the relay, not on this volume; never retrained or deleted

proposal.status: PROPOSED, for the maintainer after the independent review; nothing is deleted or moved before then
proposal.recommended: keep on am5m373kuq until the review closes (inside the $4.20 reservation, to 2026-12-24); then (a) if no authorized follow-up reads the weights, retire them under AGENTS.md 2.5 with tombstones carrying the digests above and delete the volume; (b) if a follow-up is authorized (for example Stage-3 recovery from D4-Augmented), that experiment mounts the volume in EUR-IS-2 and reads them in place, without a migration
proposal.not_recommended: migrating to the HF relay now: 4 x 2.38 GB = 9.54 GB against private storage that accepted only ~2 GB on 2026-10-22 (plans/durability_plan.json), and it needs a pod in EUR-IS-2 to read the volume; no consumer requires it
